gloss: blunder; carelessness; being caught off guard

definitions.gloss: blunder; carelessness; being caught off guard
definitions.explanation: A failure or mistake caused by lack of vigilance or awareness. Often used to describe a moment of uncharacteristic weakness or an embarrassing lapse.

examples.english: I shed tears before I knew it.

examples.japanese: {不覚|ふかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝過|ねす}ごして→寝過ごす：18375_nesugosu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I carelessly slept past my stop on the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不覚|ふかく}だった。
examples.english: Getting such an easy question wrong was a careless blunder.

notes:
{不覚|ふかく} literally means "not being aware" ({不|ふ} + {覚|かく}). It is commonly used in the set phrase {不覚|ふかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, meaning "inadvertently" or "before I realized it."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不覚|ふかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧～ (inadvertently; before I knew it)
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不覚|ふかく}だった (it was careless that...)
- {不覚|ふかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to be caught off guard; to make a blunder)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不覚|ふかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧ (tears came before I could stop them)
- {不覚|ふかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to be defeated by carelessness)

USAGE:
The phrase {不覚|ふかく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧ is a very common expression meaning someone was unexpectedly moved to tears — implying that crying was not intended and somewhat embarrassing.
